### Purging Iniquity
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/purging-iniquity
Passage: Zechariah 5:1-11
Points:
- Zechariah's visions of the flying scroll and the woman in the basket depict God purging sin rather than annihilating His covenant people.
- The flying scroll represents covenant curses against sin, ultimately fulfilled and exhausted through the death and resurrection of Christ.
- The woman inside the basket symbolizes wickedness, while her removal illustrates expiation—the lifting and carrying away of guilt.
- Two winged figures bear the basket away to Shinar, showing that evil is exiled outside the camp to its own domain.
- In the end, wickedness will be permanently banished from God's presence, while those who persist in loving sin remain confirmed in rebellion.
